text: Home Menu Locations Promotions Bari Bari Grand Contact FollowFollow a M Home Menu Locations Promotions Bari Bari Grand Contact FollowFollow Bari Bari Steak Lands in Singapore The Best Japanese-style Teppan Cuisine View Menu Welcome to Bari Bari Steak! The Sizzle. The Flavours. The Vibe. We specialize in the art of Teppan cuisine, offering a culinary journey that ranges from premium Japanese A4 Wagyu to classic Australian steaks, comforting donburis and izakaya sides. Your table is waiting for a comfortable, flavourful journey. Discover Teppan TheatreWe specialize in the art of Teppan cuisine, offering a culinary journey that ranges from premium Japanese A4 Wagyu to classic American steaks, along with Japanese-style omelette rice and pasta. Iron Pellets Imported from Japan(ステーキペレット)Our thick-cut steaks are also served with iron pellets imported from Japan. Placed on the iron griddle, these pellets maintain a high temperature, perfectly sealing in the meat’s juices. Paired with our exclusive Japanese sauce, they enhance the flavor even further. Special SauceWe traveled across Japan and carefully selected three unique yakiniku sauces: the refreshing “Yuzu Yakiniku Sauce,” the mellow “Japanese Onion Sauce,” and the rich, sweet “Bari Bari Yakiniku Sauce”—the signature heart and soul of Bari Bari Steak. Its aromatic and sweet flavor, when paired with our thick-cut steak, becomes the key to elevating the entire dining experience. Choose Your Cut. Witness the Art. Savor the art of Japanese Teppan with our premium A4 Wagyu! Choose from tenderloin, sirloin, or ribeye—each melt-in-your-mouth cut boasts perfect marbling. Seared on a sizzling iron plate, the rich aroma is irresistible! Free-Flow Fresh Salad Bar Every main order comes with unlimited access to our fresh vegetable bar, helping you balance the robust flavors of the meat. Indulge in a selection of seasonal vegetables, a delightful dessert, Japanese white rice, and a comforting soup. This thoughtful combination cleanses your palate and creates a perfect harmony of tastes. FIND OUT MORE FIND OUT MORE The Story Behind the Bowl From Japan, With Love. Kei Kaisendon was born in 2017, inspired by a founder’s unforgettable trip to Japan. After falling in love with the taste of authentic Kaisendon—a hearty bowl of fresh sashimi over rice—she came home and couldn’t find the same magic.Driven by passion, she recreated that experience in Singapore. Every bowl we serve is crafted with the freshest seafood, premium ingredients, and a whole lot of heart—just like in Japan!Kei Kaisendon is more than a meal.It’s a taste of tradition, made with love. Order now (take away & delivery) Discover Kaisendon Kaisendon (海鮮丼) is a traditional Japanese rice bowl topped with fresh, sashimi-grade seafood.The name means “seafood bowl,” and that’s exactly what it is—colorful, nourishing, and full of umami.Served over vinegared rice and paired with wasabi, soy sauce, or house-made sauces, Kaisendon is a staple in Japan’s coastal towns.At Kei Kaisendon, we bring you this authentic taste using only premium ingredients and a whole lot of heart. instore menu Kei Kaisendon: The Essence of Japanese Craftsmanship Founded in 2017, Kei Kaisendon has won prestigious awards for 4 consecutive years, showcasing its profound heritage and exceptional quality.The brand originated from a fishing village in Hokkaido. Founder Kei, with a deep affection for the sea, established the brand with the aim of spreading the true essence of Japanese cuisine, incorporating humanistic care and warmth to let diners fully enjoy the true taste. Kei’s original intention is to convey the unique enjoyment of fresh seafood flavors.The secret of “Strictly controlling the freshness of ingredients, and crafting exquisite flavors” – selecting fresh salmon from Norwegian waters, and fresh farm vegetables, paired with the founder’s secret Kei sauce, blending with the richness of rice. Every bite is an intertwining of the essence of the sea and land. text: Select Far East Malls... Home Shops Shops Happenings Happenings Deals Deals Lease Lease Contact Contact About Us Lease With Us FAQ Find us at © 2026. Far East Organization. All rights reserved. Bijou Clarke Quay Central Far East Square Greenwich V HillV2 Hougang 1 Icon Village Junction 10 Katong V Lucky Chinatown One Holland Village Orchard Central Pacific Plaza Parksuites Riverside Point Siglap Centre Square 2 West Coast Plaza Mess Hall at Sentosa Woods Square About Us Lease With Us Shopfareast Rewards FAQ Home Discover Kimpson's Table KIMPSON'S TABLE Home-style Korean Food Kimpson's Table Operating hours: Tue to Sun: 11:30am – 2:30pm & 5:00 pm – 10pm (Last Order at 9:30pm) Mon: ClosedOur 11th chef at Chef X @ Clarke Quay Central is Kimpson's Table, operating from 16 January to 13 March 2026. We spoke to founder, Patrick Kim, to find out more about his journey. Originally a semiconductor engineering major, Patrick traded silicon wafers for sauté pans after discovering a deep-seated passion for the culinary arts. After honing his skills in Italian and Japanese kitchens and later serving as a head chef in Singapore, he is now using the Chef X platform to bring his most personal project to life. Kimpson’s Table was born from a singular, heartfelt mission: to provide the comforting, "mother’s home-cooked" experience that many Koreans living abroad—and locals alike—deeply crave. Inspired by the banchan (side dish) delivery culture of Korea, the menu is designed to offer wholesome, healthy meals that does not compromise on flavour. Every dish is a tribute to family. By blending professional expertise with recipes passed down from his mother and grandmother, Patrick ensures that every bite feels less like a transaction and more like an invitation into his home. All dishes are low-sodium, low-sugar, and made entirely in-house. Being a part of Chef X @ Clarke Quay Central For Patrick, this residency is more than just a pop-up; it is a vital proving ground. Having spent a decade managing and leading kitchens, he is using the space at Chef X to test his concept in a physical retail setting. "This platform allows me to see how customers respond to Kimpson’s Table in a physical space," he shares. "Our goal is to use this two-month experience to prepare for the opening of our very own offline store." Specially curated for Chef X @ Clarke Quay Central The curated menu at Chef X is headlined by the Authentic Ginseng Chicken Set (Samgyetang), served with nourishing soup, rice, and three side dishes. For those seeking classic comforts can tuck into hearty Beef and Spicy Pork Bulgogi Sets or savour the regional special of the ChunCheon Style Spicy Chicken Set. These mains are perfectly complemented by a selection of handcrafted sides, including Kimchi Pancake, Deep Fried Dumpling, and Boneless Chicken available in Original, Bburringkle Cheese, or Sweet & Spicy seasoning. To complete the experience, guests can enjoy traditional Korean soft drinks like Sik-hye and Bong-bong Grape Juice or opt for Soju and Beer. Check out the full menu here. About Chef X @ Clarke Quay Central Chef X @ Clarke Quay Central is an initiative by Far East Organization that provides home-based chefs and private dining chefs with a sandbox to operate their own full-fledged commercial restaurant within Clarke Quay Central mall for four or eight weeks. From 26 April 2024, each resident chef will serve out of a professionally designed F&B space fitted with commercial-grade kitchen equipment, with a dining area that can accommodate up to 24 diners.Apart from physical resources, resident chefs will be offered guidance. They can look forward to receiving advice and tips - from menu planning, food presentation and recipe refinements, to business and human resource management, from Chef Isaac Tan, Head of Culinary & Product Innovations for Commonwealth Concepts (CWC), the F&B joint venture between Commonwealth Capital and Far East Organization. An industry veteran who has led dining institutions such as Bedrock Bar & Grill since its inception in 2008, Chef Isaac Tan currently steers 12 distinct brands under the group, including Fat Cow, Kinki Restaurant + Bar, and The Marmalade Pantry.Each resident chef, who will helm the restaurant for four or eight weeks, will showcase their culinary skills and individual styles, cooking at the unit for dine-in customers, with the option of takeaway.Head down to Chef X @ Clarke Quay Central #03-103 today. Need directions to Chef X? Check our Instagram highlights! Interested to join as a chef and be part of Chef X?Chef X is currently fully lined-up for 2025. Stay tuned to this space for updates.
